---
name: "Prepare Research Release"
description: "Prepare and validate the synchronized paper, evidence, site, citation, and release artifacts without approving the release gate."
agent: "research-lead"
tools: [read, edit, search, execute, agent]
---

Run the release checks, regenerate all public artifacts, request an independent
falsification review, and prepare a release-gate summary. Fix reproducibility or
packaging defects that do not alter scientific claims. Stop for human review if
any claim, limitation, citation, or gate decision would change.
